premium.title: Premium feature

importExtrato.title: Statement import is premium
importExtrato.description: Import supported statements to speed up your finances without typing everything manually.

importFatura.title: Credit card import is premium
importFatura.description: Send supported credit card statements and review entries before saving.

importConta.title: Bill import is premium
importConta.description: Send supported bills, PIX and slips to cut manual entry.

importInvestimentos.title: Investments import is premium
importInvestimentos.description: Import supported broker statements to track your portfolio without typing everything.

ocrGasto.title: Expense OCR is premium
ocrGasto.description: Use image reading to turn supported receipts into organized entries.

investimentos.title: Investments is a premium feature
investimentos.description: Track assets, transactions and wealth growth in one place. Available on higher plans.

cartoes.title: Cards and statements is a premium feature
cartoes.description: Organize credit cards and follow statements with more control. Available on higher plans.

assinaturas.title: Subscriptions is a premium feature
assinaturas.description: Control subscriptions and recurring charges in one place. Available on higher plans.

contasAPagar.title: Bills to pay is a premium feature
contasAPagar.description: Schedule and follow bills to pay without missing due dates. Available on higher plans.

contasAReceber.title: Bills to receive is a premium feature
contasAReceber.description: Track expected income and keep your cash flow healthy. Available on higher plans.

orcamento.title: Budget is a premium feature
orcamento.description: Set category limits and follow spending with more clarity. Available on higher plans.

relatorios.title: Advanced reports is a premium feature
relatorios.description: Compare periods, view detailed charts and follow your financial evolution in more depth.

gastoAi.title: Financial AI is a premium feature
gastoAi.description: Get smart insights about your spending, patterns and savings opportunities.

metas.title: Goals is a premium feature
metas.description: Create visual financial goals and follow your progress. Available on higher plans.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp is a premium feature
whatsapp.description: Log expenses by WhatsApp quickly and easily. Available on higher plans.

renda.title: Income is a premium feature
renda.description: Organize your income without entry limits. Available on higher plans.

guardado.title: Savings is a premium feature
guardado.description: Follow saved amounts and reserves with more control. Available on higher plans.

contasConectadas.title: Connected accounts is a premium feature
contasConectadas.description: Invite someone by email and follow their account with permission. Available on higher plans.

empresa.title: Smart Company is for MEI and Company plans
empresa.description: Look up CNPJ and keep your company data organized. Available on Essencial for MEI, MEI Completo and Empresa plans.

fornecedores.title: Suppliers is for MEI and Company plans
fornecedores.description: Register suppliers by CNPJ and organize business expenses better.

clientes.title: Clients is for MEI and Company plans
clientes.description: Register clients by CNPJ and organize business income better.

contador.title: Accountant package is for MEI and Company plans
contador.description: Generate an organized monthly summary to send to your accountant.

mercadoAvancado.title: Full Smart Market is a premium feature
mercadoAvancado.description: Access purchase history, price comparison, default basket and saved markets to shop with more control.

mercadoImportarCupom.title: Receipt import is a premium feature
mercadoImportarCupom.description: Import receipts via QR Code/NFC-e to cut manual entry.

importacoes.title: Smart Import is a premium feature
importacoes.description: Import supported invoices, statements, PDFs and images to cut manual entry.
